description: This file defines Swagger API documentation classes for the Savings Accounts API in the Apache Fineract project. It contains nested classes with schema annotations for request and response models related to savings accounts, such as retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting savings account data.

classes.name: SavingsAccountsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes defining Swagger documentation schemas for various savings account API responses and requests.

classes.name: GetSavingsAccountsTemplateResponse
classes.description: Schema class for the response template when fetching savings account options.

classes.name: GetSavingsProductOptions
classes.description: Represents options for savings products within the template response.

classes.name: GetSavingsAccountsResponse
classes.description: Schema class for the overall savings accounts response containing a list of account items.

classes.name: GetSavingsPageItems
classes.description: Represents individual savings account data within the response.

classes.name: GetSavingsStatus
classes.description: Details about the status of a savings account.

classes.name: GetSavingsTimeline
classes.description: Timeline information for savings account submission, approval, activation dates, and submitter/approver info.

classes.name: GetSavingsCurrency
classes.description: Currency details associated with the savings account.

classes.name: GetSavingsInterestCompoundingPeriodType
classes.description: Interest compounding period type details.

classes.name: GetSavingsInterestPostingPeriodType
classes.description: Interest posting period type details.

classes.name: GetSavingsInterestCalculationType
classes.description: Interest calculation type details.

classes.name: GetSavingsInterestCalculationDaysInYearType
classes.description: Interest calculation days in a year type.

classes.name: GetSavingsSummary
classes.description: Summary data of the savings account, including currency and balance.

classes.name: PostSavingsAccountsRequest
classes.description: Schema for request to create a new savings account.

classes.name: PostSavingsAccountsResponse
classes.description: Response schema after creating a savings account.

classes.name: GetSavingsAccountsAccountIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for detailed savings account info fetched by account ID.

classes.name: GetSavingsAccountsSummary
classes.description: Summary info for a specific savings account.

classes.name: PutSavingsAccountsAccountIdRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating savings account info.

classes.name: PutSavingsAccountsAccountIdResponse
classes.description: Response after updating a savings account.

classes.name: PostSavingsAccountsAccountIdRequest
classes.description: Schema for specific account updates.

classes.name: PostSavingsAccountsAccountIdResponse
classes.description: Response after specific account update.

classes.name: DeleteSavingsAccountsAccountIdResponse
classes.description: Response after deleting a savings account by ID.
